summary: The StaffEducation module in HSPnet manages staff educational records, allowing for operations such as adding, updating, and deleting educational data for staff members. The system interfaces with a database to maintain these records, facilitating the tracking of educational programs, student numbers, graduation details, and consent forms.
purpose: To manage and maintain staff education records within the HSPnet system, ensuring accurate tracking and reporting of educational data linked to staff members.

workflows.name: Add Staff Education
steps: Initialize a StaffEducation object
Check for required fields (ProgramID, etc.)
Validate the object
Set database procedure to StaffEducationAdd
Add parameters for session and education details
Execute the query in the database

workflows.name: Update Staff Education
steps: Initialize a StaffEducation object
Check for required fields (ProgramID, ConsentObtained, etc.)
Validate the object
Set database procedure to StaffEducationUpdate
Add parameters for session and education details
Execute the query in the database

workflows.name: Delete Staff Education
steps: Check for valid EducationID
Set database procedure to StaffEducationDelete
Add parameters for session and education details
Execute the query in the database

workflows.name: Search Staff Education
steps: Set database procedure to StaffEducationSearch
Add parameters for session and StaffID
Execute the query and retrieve data
Populate StaffEducation objects from the data

business_rules: ProgramID must be specified for education operations.
Authorizing user must be specified if Release is authorized.
Student number cannot be blank if consent is obtained.
validations: Check whether ProgramID is greater than zero.
Validate the existence of required fields before executing database procedures.
Verify the consent and release conditions before proceeding with updates.
conditions: ProgramID must be greater than zero.
ReleaseAuthorized requires AuthorizingStaffID to not equal Database.NullInt.
StudentNumber must not be blank if ConsentObtained is true.
system_behavior: The system retrieves staff education records based on StaffID or EducationID using database procedures.
The system formats phone numbers and staff names for display.
The system manages linking icons for authorized or half-authorized entries.
dependencies: Resource strings for UI elements and error messages
exceptions: Error added to session messages if ProgramID is zero during add or update operations.
Error added to session messages if AuthorizingStaffID is missing during release authorization.
